problem_statement: Build a brand-new About page at the /about route for the Modernize admin dashboard (vite + React + MUI). The route does not exist yet. Create the page from scratch inside the existing dashboard shell, reusing the site's design system (PageContainer, DashboardCard, BlankCard, the MUI theme, Grid spacing and Typography variants). The page should tell the product's story: a hero introducing the company, a mission statement, a company stats strip, a values section, and a closing call-to-action. No interactivity is required.
required_content: A hero DashboardCard with an 'Our Story' chip, an h2 heading 'About Modernize', and an introductory paragraph.
A mission section (BlankCard) with a 'Mission' chip and an h3 'Our Mission' plus a paragraph describing the mission.
A stats strip (BlankCard) showing three company metrics laid out in a responsive Grid.
A values section (BlankCard) with a 'What we value' chip and three value entries, each an h3 title ('Clarity First', 'Built to Scale', 'Customer Obsessed') with a supporting paragraph.
A closing call-to-action DashboardCard with an h3 and a primary 'Join the Team' button.
design_constraints: Use the existing MUI baselightTheme (primary #5D87FF); no new colors.
Grid container spacing={3}; Typography variants h2 (hero) / h3 (section + value titles) / body1 (paragraphs).
Mount the page inside FullLayout so the sidebar/topbar/footer shell renders.
Palette tokens (from the MUI baselightTheme): primary #5D87FF; heading/body dark text #2A3547; muted secondary text #5A6A85; card surfaces white #ffffff. Do not introduce colors outside this set.
Typography uses the "Plus Jakarta Sans" font family; hero h2 ~30px/600 weight, section & value h3 ~24px/600 weight, body1 paragraphs ~14-16px/400 weight.
author_notes: Plan A: baseline leaves /about as an empty route element (blank #root); reference implements the full About page; bad drops the entire Values section (breaks dom_assertions on the three value h3s + the 'What we value' completion signal). Three workspace source trees are md5-distinct.
